Strategy: Fill three quarters of the bin. Prefer the bin where the item takes three quarters of the residual, leaving one quarter free: mostly tight, yet keeping a small useful remainder. Score by distance from a three-quarters fill, so ranking can differ from Best Fit whenever the three-quarters bin is not the tightest. It may help by keeping placements tight yet reusable, but may fail by passing up exact fits for bins that stay one quarter empty.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(abs(item / r - 3 / 4)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Three-quarters fill targeting: score by -abs(item/r - 3/4), prefer residual = 4/3*item.
